revelations.name: Battlecry
revelations.summary: Inspire allies within 100 feet with a scaling morale bonus.

revelations.name: Battlefield Clarity
revelations.summary: Reroll a failed save against debilitating battlefield conditions.

revelations.name: Combat Healer
revelations.summary: Cast cure spells swiftly by spending two spell slots.

revelations.name: Iron Skin
revelations.summary: Gain DR 10/adamantine as stoneskin.

revelations.name: Maneuver Mastery
revelations.summary: Master one combat maneuver and its feat chain.

revelations.name: Resiliency
revelations.summary: Remain effective at 0 hit points and gain Diehard.

revelations.name: Skill at Arms
revelations.summary: Gain martial weapon and heavy armor proficiency.

revelations.name: Surprising Charge
revelations.summary: Move immediately outside your turn.

revelations.name: War Sight
revelations.summary: Roll initiative multiple times and master surprise rounds.

revelations.name: Weapon Mastery
revelations.summary: Gain scaling focus and critical feats with one weapon.

mysteries.finalRevelation: Become an avatar of battle: combine a full attack with movement, ignore DR on critical hits, resist confirmed criticals, and survive deeper into negative hit points.

revelations.name: Armor of Bones
revelations.summary: Conjure scaling armor and bludgeoning resistance.

revelations.name: Bleeding Wounds
revelations.summary: Negative energy causes scaling bleed damage.

revelations.name: Death's Touch
revelations.summary: Harm living creatures or heal undead with a touch.

revelations.name: Near Death
revelations.summary: Resist disease, poison, mental effects, death, sleep, and stunning.

revelations.name: Raise the Dead
revelations.summary: Temporarily summon a scaling undead servant.

revelations.name: Resist Life
revelations.summary: Interact with energy as undead and gain channel resistance.

revelations.name: Soul Siphon
revelations.summary: Bestow a negative level and heal yourself.

revelations.name: Spirit Walk
revelations.summary: Become incorporeal and invisible while moving.

revelations.name: Undead Servitude
revelations.summary: Command undead using dedicated negative-energy channeling.

revelations.name: Voice of the Grave
revelations.summary: Speak with dead for scaling rounds each day.

mysteries.finalRevelation: Master death: cast bleed or stabilize freely, stabilize automatically, animate dead without material cost, and use power word kill once per day against a broadened hit-point threshold.
